title: New starter needs an account
symptom: A new employee starts Monday and needs an account
user_description: We have a new colleague starting Monday. Can you set up everything they need? I'll let you know what later.

options.text: Give the new starter a colleague's login for now
options.why: Shared logins destroy accountability and are a security risk. Every person needs their own account.

options.text: Create the account with full admin rights so nothing blocks them
options.why: Violates least privilege. People should only get the access their job needs.

options.text: Check there is an approved request with the role and required access, then create the account with only that access
options.why: An approved request proves the account is genuine and shows exactly what to grant. Only giving the access the role needs limits risk if the account is ever misused.

hints: Who has approved this request, and what does the person need to do their job?
How much access should a new person get on day one?
real_world_tip: Use a standard onboarding checklist or template per role. It saves time and avoids missing access.
